'''David William Gruen''' {{Post-nominals|country=AUS|AO|FASSA}} (born 31 August 1954) is an Australian statistician and mathematician. He is the current Australian Statistician at the [[Australian Bureau of Statistics]] serving since 11 December 2019. He previously served as Deputy Secretary, Economic and Australia's G20 Sherpa at the [[Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (Australia)|Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet]]. He previously held office as the executive director of the Macroeconomic group of [[Treasury (Australia)|Australian Treasury]] and was the head of the Economic Research Department of the [[Reserve Bank of Australia]] from 1998 to 2002.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-02-06 |title=The Australian Statistician {{!}} Australian Bureau of Statistics |url=https://www.abs.gov.au/about/our-organisation/australian-statistician |access-date=2024-01-11 |website=www.abs.gov.au |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=From maths to economics: David Gruen |url=https://www.monash.edu/science/alumni-old/alumni-archived/graduates/david-gruen |access-date=2024-01-11 |website=Science |language=en}}</ref>

Gruen was appointed an [[Order of Australia|Officer of the Order of Australia]] in the [[2022 Australia Day Honours]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr David William Gruen |url=https://honours.pmc.gov.au/honours/awards/2010462 |access-date=2024-01-12 |website=Australian Honours Search Facility}}</ref> He was elected a Fellow of the [[Academy of the Social Sciences in Australia]] in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-08 |title=The Academy of the Social Sciences in Australia welcomes 21 new Fellows |url=https://socialsciences.org.au/news/celebrating-excellence-21-new-fellows-inducted-into-the-academy-of-the-social-sciences-in-australia/ |access-date=2024-01-12 |website=Academy of the Social Sciences in Australia |language=en-AU}}</ref>
